code.basis: Lines: executable statements (no branch measurement) in the system's own source, the 7 files of the interceptor package (interceptor/__init__.py, interceptor/errors.py, interceptor/formats.py, interceptor/github_source.py, interceptor/jenkins_source.py, interceptor/service.py, interceptor/source.py); the coverage instrumentation itself, third-party libraries, the tester and tests are excluded. Measured in-process with coverage.py 7.17.0 (sysmon core, all threads) from POST /test/setup until the first GET /test/report for this session, or until the next session's setup if that comes first. Statements that run only at import time (imports, def and class lines) execute before any session and so count as not covered. The measurement is process-wide, so other traffic during the session is included.

component.basis: Components defined by the pod specification (the profile's 'components'); a component counts as covered when at least one executed test (pass or fail) exercises it.

model.basis: Team 24 design requirements for Phase 5 (REQ-01..REQ-08), design version: Team 24 design, Project Phase #2 section 4 requirements REQ-01..REQ-08 as traced in docs/phase3-spec.md (model revision 1). A requirement counts once, as covered when at least one executed test (pass or fail) evaluates it. Requirement-to-test mapping: https://github.com/atipre/ece_30861_project/blob/main/docs/design-requirements.md

system.basis: Acceptance criteria AC-01..AC-08 in scope from the shared pod specification (Phase 2 section 4.1). Each criterion counts once, as covered when the suite evaluated it (its test ran to pass or fail); skipped criteria are not covered.
